title: An Indian Wedding
description: An Indian wedding isn't an event — it's a festival that lasts for days, with colors, music, feasts and a thousand smiling guests. #indianwedding #india #culture #wedding

scenes.text: An Indian wedding isn't an event. It's an entire festival.
Celebrations that stretch across three, four, even five days.
A bride draped in gold and the richest colors.
Music, dancing, and joy that never seems to stop.
Feasts with a hundred dishes and a thousand guests.
In India, two people marry, but two whole worlds unite.
